whatIs: SmoothUI is a set of 228 animated primitives and components for React, built with Tailwind, shadcn/ui and Motion. They're organized into primitives, components, blocks and templates, and the code is copied into your project.
It's a good fit when you use shadcn/ui and want to add polished animations without writing them from scratch.
uses: Adding an animated component, like an orb, to a screen with a single command.
Replacing static elements on a landing page with versions that have smooth transitions.
Starting from an animated template or block to build a product page.
caveats: It requires React, Tailwind and the shadcn CLI; it doesn't work as is in other frameworks.
The animations use Motion and, in some components, GSAP, which add weight to the bundle.
The code lives in your repository, so later improvements are applied by hand.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; there's no paid plan.
idealFor: shadcn/ui projects that want ready-to-use animations.
